english: My owner is Mike, a student in Sunshine Middle School.
chinese: 我的主人是迈克，阳光中学的一名学生。

english: At 7:30 a.m., he takes me to class and uses me to take notes carefully-he is so diligent.
chinese: 早上7:30，他带我去上课，用我仔细地记笔记——他真是太勤奋了。

english: On the playground at 10:00 a.m., he leaves me in the desk to play basketball, looking relaxed and happy.
chinese: 上午10:00在操场上，他把我留在课桌里去打篮球，看起来轻松又开心。

english: After school, he brings me home.
At 7:00 p.m., he uses me to finish his homework, working quietly until it's done.
chinese: 晚上7:00，他用我完成家庭作业，安安静静地写，直到完成。

english: By 9:00 p.m., he puts me down, tired but satisfied.
chinese: 到了晚上9:00，他放下我，虽然疲惫但很满足。

english: Mike's day is busy but full.
chinese: 迈克的一天忙碌而充实。

english: I'm glad to be with him through every moment.
chinese: 我很高兴能陪伴他度过每一个时刻。
